features.name: NER Entity Extraction
features.description: Extract named entities from draft text using GLiNER

tests.notes: Tests cover HF Space SSE response parsing, entity normalization, short-token filtering, and initialism deduplication.

features.notes: v1: used Pioneer.ai API (now defunct). v2: migrating to self-hosted GLiNER on HF Space (see F020).

features.name: Sentence Embedding Generation
features.description: Generate embeddings using all-MiniLM-L6-v2

tests.notes: Tests cover embed_text and batch embedding via HF Space, plus 384-dim vector validation.

features.notes: v1: local SentenceTransformer on Render. v2: migrating to self-hosted MiniLM on HF Space (see F020). Local model kept as dev fallback when MODELS_SPACE_URL is unset.

features.name: Qdrant Vector Search
features.description: Search for semantically similar article chunks via Qdrant

tests.notes: No Go tests yet. Search is exercised indirectly through handler integration tests.

features.notes: Configured for local Qdrant by default during development while preserving hosted deployment support via optional API key.

features.name: Equity-Aware Re-ranking
features.description: Re-rank candidates based on similarity and link equity need

tests.notes: Tests cover equity_need, final_score, URL-level candidate collapse, exclusion of already-selected URLs, and final score ordering.

features.notes: Reranking collapses duplicate chunk hits down to one best candidate per URL before scoring, which prevents a single article from occupying multiple slots during recommendation generation.

features.name: Sitemap Crawl and Ingest
features.description: Crawl sitemap, extract article text, chunk and upsert to Qdrant

tests.notes: Tests cover sliding-window text chunking and internal link graph construction from sitemap crawls.

features.notes: v1: synchronous single-request ingest — times out on Render free tier for 150+ article sitemaps. v2: converting to async job queue via Redis + goroutine pool (see F021, F022, F023).

features.name: Recommend API Endpoint
features.description: POST /api/v1/recommend - analyze text and return link recommendations

tests.notes: Integration tests with mocked core modules cover min_similarity forwarding, widened retrieval depth, and URL-diverse recommendations across multiple entities.

features.notes: Recommend requests query a wider candidate pool, rerank at the URL level, and avoid repeating the same destination URL within a single response unless new URLs are exhausted.

tests.notes: Tests cover single-article ingest validation and upsert.

features.name: HF Space Model Serving
features.description: Self-host GLiNER and MiniLM inference on a combined HuggingFace Space (eros483/autolinks-models) with FastAPI endpoints POST /extract, POST /embed, and GET /health.

tests.notes: Test Space endpoints return correct entity and embedding shapes. Test health endpoint reports both models loaded.

subtasks: Create Space Dockerfile with fastapi, uvicorn, sentence-transformers, gliner
Implement POST /extract endpoint wrapping fastino/gliner2-base-v1
Implement POST /embed endpoint wrapping all-MiniLM-L6-v2
Implement GET /health endpoint with model load status
Set HF_HOME=/data/hf_cache for persistent model caching
Deploy via hf spaces create + hf upload
features.notes: Single Space serves both models. cpu-basic free tier (16GB RAM) is ample. Models loaded at startup to avoid cold-start penalty on first request. Benefits: frees ~150MB RAM from Render web and worker services.

features.name: Async Ingestion Job Queue
features.description: Replace Celery with in-process goroutine worker pool (4 workers, semaphore-bounded, 3 retries with backoff). API returns job_id; workers process in background.

tests.notes: Tests cover job creation, status tracking, progress reporting, and completion using miniredis.

subtasks: Add go-redis dependency for Redis job state management
Create goroutine worker pool (4 workers, semaphore-bounded at 5 concurrent fetches)
Create JobManager (generate job_id, track status/progress, store results in Redis)
Create worker task wrapping crawl_and_extract -> build_link_graph -> ingest_article flow
Add GET /ingest/status/{job_id} and GET /ingest/result/{job_id} endpoints
Refactor POST /ingest/sitemap to enqueue job instead of running synchronously
Add Upstash REDIS_URL and REDIS_SSL config vars
features.notes: Fixes Render free-tier timeout for 150+ article sitemap ingests. Job lifecycle: queued -> processing -> done/failed. Celery concurrency=8 gives parallel article processing.

features.name: Dead Letter Queue
features.description: Store permanently failed ingestion jobs (after max retries) in a Redis-backed DLQ. Expose retry endpoint for manual reprocessing.

tests.notes: Tests cover DLQ push on failure, pop for retry, max retry exhaustion, and manual reprocessing using miniredis.

subtasks: Create DeadLetterQueue using Redis list dlq:ingest
Store failed job metadata: job_id, task_name, args, error, timestamp, retry_count
Configure worker with max_retries=3 and on_failure push to DLQ
Add POST /ingest/retry-dead endpoint to pop and re-enqueue failed jobs
features.notes: Failed jobs accumulate in DLQ for inspection. Manual trigger via API retries them. Prevents silent data loss during sitemap crawls.

features.name: Goroutine Worker Pool
features.description: In-process goroutine worker pool (4 workers) replaces Celery. No separate deployment needed.

tests.notes: Worker pool is exercised indirectly through job manager integration tests.

subtasks: Create worker pool in cmd/server/main.go (starts with HTTP server, no separate process)
Configure concurrency: 4 workers, semaphore-bounded at 5 concurrent fetches
Configure worker environment variables (MODELS_SPACE_URL, REDIS_URL, QDRANT_*, HF_API_KEY)
Set up Upstash Redis connection with TLS support
No separate deployment needed -- worker pool runs in-process
features.notes: Worker is a separate Render free-tier service. No web port needed — Render supports Background Worker type. Concurrency=8 possible because models are offloaded to HF Space (worker RAM ~80MB).

features.name: GitHub Actions CI
features.description: Automated CI pipeline on push/PR to main: backend tests (go test -race + go vet + go fmt), frontend tests (vitest + eslint).

tests.notes: CI workflow self-validates by running: the CI pipeline is the test.

subtasks: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with backend and frontend jobs
Backend: setup-go, go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., go fmt -l .
Frontend: setup-node, npm ci, npm run lint, npm run test
features.notes: Runs on every push and PR to main. Uses official go and node setup actions. Coverage report in CI output.

features.name: External Keepalive (cron-job.org)
features.description: Scheduled cron job (every 10 min) pinging Render backend API, HF Models Space, and Qdrant Cloud to prevent free-tier sleep. Migrated from GitHub Actions to cron-job.org.

tests.notes: Manually verified via cron-job.org run history and curl exit codes.

subtasks: Create 3 cron-job.org jobs with */10 min schedule
Ping Render: GET https://autolinks.onrender.com/api/v1/health
Ping HF Space: GET https://eros483-autolinks-models.hf.space/
Ping Qdrant: GET https://<qdrant-host>:6333/collections with api-key header
features.notes: Free-tier services sleep after ~15 min of inactivity. Keepalive prevents cold-start penalty on real requests. External cron is more reliable than GitHub Actions scheduled workflows (which skip inactive repos). Replaces deleted .github/workflows/keepalive.yml.

features.name: Go Multi-Stage Dockerfile

features.name: Go Backend Migration
features.description: Rewrite the entire backend from Python/FastAPI to Go/chi. Replace Celery with in-process goroutine worker pool. Swap trafilatura for go-trafilatura. Remove local sentence-transformers fallback. Rewrite all 52 tests and 3 eval scripts in Go.

tests.notes: 50 Go tests passing across 7 test files. Tests cover entity extraction, embedding, re-ranking, chunking, link graph, handlers, job manager, and DLQ. Uses testify/assert and miniredis for mocking.

Phase 3: Ingest modules (chunk, crawl, linkgraph)
Phase 4: Models (request/response structs)

features.notes: Goroutine pool (4 workers, semaphore-bounded at 5 concurrent fetches, 3 retries with exponential backoff 30s/60s/120s, DLQ in Redis) replaces Celery entirely. Qdrant gRPC client (port 6334) replaces Python REST client. All 8 API endpoints preserved with byte-for-byte compatible JSON shapes. Image size ~15MB, RAM idle ~25MB, cold start <1s.
